target_applications: bento/prepared-food factories: bulk food picking into bento boxes/trays

base_type.value: pedestal on casters (manual repositioning, no self-drive)

torso_lift.value: fixed torso; shoulder width ~400mm fits human work slot

actuators.value: hybrid torque/position controlled servo motors ('soft control')

sensors_head.value: AI vision camera system (Foodly AI Vision / NEKONOTE), deep-learning bulk-food segmentation, lighting-robust

compute.value: NVIDIA Jetson-class embedded GPU (RT stack); details n/a

software_stack.value: TensorFlow deep learning; ROS-compatible; teaching-less operation via panel; Foodly TypeR research model

safety_compliance.value: collaborative by design: soft torque-limited control, pinch-free arms, status lights; no public ISO cert

availability.value: Japan; direct sale + monthly rental, per-factory customization

deployment_evidence.value: Hirai (Kumamoto) bento line; Ichibiki (Aichi) retort side-dish line; Will of Factory staffing partnership; METI FY2020/21 projects; ~800 portions/hour throughput claim

notes: One of very few humanoid-form robots in paid food-factory production work; throughput ~800 meals/h vendor-claimed.
